channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: De encontros com evangélicos a início de campanha em missa, Tarcísio busca apoio de setores religiosos
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas has intensified outreach to religious sectors, particularly evangelical and Catholic leaders, through meetings with figures like Apostle Estevam Hernandes and participation in religious events such as the Canção Nova Abraça São Paulo mass. His speeches emphasized faith and social responsibility, while allies like Mayor Ricardo Nunes made veiled criticisms of opponents, associating them with 'liars' and church persecutors. Tarcísio avoided direct vote appeals, focusing instead on his governance record and longstanding ties to the evangelical community.

item.title: Campanhas de Tarcísio e Haddad consultaram mesmo especialista em segurança
item.description: The campaigns of Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and Fernando Haddad (PT) consulted the same public security expert, Leandro Piquet, who noted convergences in their concerns, including organized crime’s infiltration into legal sectors like fuel, money laundering, and gaming platforms, as well as the need to improve crime resolution, especially femicide investigations. Despite differing solutions, both candidates agree on the importance of inter-institutional coordination between state and municipal guards to prevent organized crime from territorial control.

item.title: Presidenciável quer proibir pesquisas que não o chamem de veterinário
item.description: Presidential candidate Wilson Grassi (Democrat) has filed legal actions against over a dozen polling institutes for failing to use his official ballot name, 'Veterinário Wilson Grassi', in electoral surveys. He argues that omitting the 'veterinarian' title undermines voter identification and biases results, requesting the TSE to ban dissemination of polls that do not correctly reference him. His campaign claims to have identified 24 ongoing polls referring to him only as 'Wilson Grassi' or 'Wilson Grassi Jr'.

item.title: Desembargadora se declara suspeita de apreciar candidatura de Moro
item.description: Federal judge Gisele Lemke, serving as a justice in the Paraná Electoral Court (TRE-PR), declared herself disqualified from ruling on cases related to Sérgio Moro’s gubernatorial candidacy, citing her proximity to Lava Jato-era magistrates that compromises impartiality. This marks the second time she has recused herself in cases involving the former Lava Jato judge, having done so in 2023 at the TRF-4. Her prior rulings favoring Deltan Dallagnol’s candidacy were later challenged and partially suspended by Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino.

item.title: Quem são os conselheiros de Tarcísio na campanha à reeleição em SP
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas' re-election campaign in São Paulo is advised by specialists in public security, education, and environment, coordinated by Natália Resende. The team includes figures such as Osvaldo Nico, Henguel Ricardo Pereira, and consultants from Comunitas, which developed the 'Pacto Pelo Futuro', along with Cláudia Costin in education. Some advisors, like Leandro Piquet, have prior experience working with opposing campaigns, including Fernando Haddad's.

item.title: Mais de 3 mil candidatos trocaram de partido desde 2022; veja as legendas que mais ganharam e perderam nomes
item.description: A g1 survey reveals that 3,681 candidates who ran in the 2022 elections are now running in 2026 under a different party, representing 58% of the total. The PL party gained the most candidates (349), while União Brasil lost the most (273). Novo recorded the highest net gain (+173), with significant inflows from PL and PTB.

item.title: 'O Brasil pronto pra mais'; 'O Brasil vai vencer' e mais: veja slogans dos candidatos à Presidência do Brasil
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian presidential campaign officially began on Sunday (16), with candidates already revealing their slogans and campaign materials. Lula (PT) uses 'Brasil pronto pra mais', while Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) opts for 'Brasil vai vencer'. Other candidates, including Renan Santos (Missão), Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), Romeu Zema (Novo) and Augusto Cury (Avante), have also launched their campaign slogans, now permitting explicit voter outreach through rallies, social media and paid advertisements.

item.title: Ministros do TSE se reúnem nesta terça para discutir uso de deepfakes na campanha eleitoral
item.description: The TSE met on Tuesday to discuss a potential broad or selective ban on deepfakes in electoral campaigns, favoring a total prohibition to avoid an influx of legal challenges. The meeting also considered penalties such as fines and warnings, and was prompted by a PT lawsuit against an AI-generated video showing Jair Bolsonaro at the PL convention. The debate takes place while Bolsonaro serves house arrest for his conviction in the coup plot.

item.title: Tarcísio repudia hostilidade a Marina em ato: "Não podemos admitir"
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas condemned the hostility faced by Senate candidate Marina Silva during a campaign event with Fernando Haddad, stating that disagreements must not turn into violence or intimidation. He expressed full solidarity with Marina and emphasized the importance of respecting freedom of expression and uniting against violence against women, which he called a 'scourge'. The incident involved an unidentified man verbally attacking Marina, telling her she 'returned to the scene of the crime'.

item.title: Defesa de ex-secretário do Maranhão quer o impedimento de Dino
item.description: The defense of former Maranhão secretary Raimundo Cutrim filed a request to disqualify Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino from overseeing investigations against him, arguing Dino is himself under investigation for alleged persecution. Cutrim is probed for allegedly obstructing a 2022 homicide investigation and leaking information to journalist Luís Pablo, while Dino ordered the precautionary removal of TCE-MA President Daniel Brandão, nephew of the governor, over suspicions of interference in the probe.

item.title: Mendonça manda Lula remover das redes trechos de vídeos com pedidos explícitos de voto em convenção
item.description: TSE Minister André Mendonça ordered Lula, Jerônimo Rodrigues, and the PT to edit or remove YouTube video excerpts containing explicit vote requests made during the Bahia state convention, ruling they constitute premature electoral propaganda. The decision partially grants a Novo party petition but rejects total removal of the content. Lula urged votes for himself, Jerônimo, Wagner, and Rui Costa, emphasizing that electoral law permits no exception for intraparty settings when speech includes direct or semantically equivalent calls to vote.

item.title: TSE registra maior queda de candidaturas em 3 décadas, sob efeito de federações e de partido de Marçal
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) recorded the largest drop in candidacies for the 2026 general elections since 1994, driven by the formation of party federations and the influence of Pablo Marçal’s new party. This trend reflects a strategic reorganization of Brazil’s political landscape, with fewer isolated candidacies and greater concentration in alliances.

item.title: Piquet ganha tênis com nome de Bolsonaro de aniversário
item.description: Nelson Piquet, three-time Formula 1 world champion, turned 74 on August 17, 2026, and received a pair of green, yellow, and blue sneakers bearing Jair Bolsonaro’s name as a birthday gift from the Bolsonaro-branded footwear line, Botinas Bolsonaro, created by his supporters in 2024. The celebration took place at the family farm in Brasília, with photos shared by his nephew Marcelo Piquet on Instagram. This is not the first Bolsonaro-themed gift Piquet has received — in 2025, he was given a shirt featuring the ex-president’s face, underscoring his public support for the former leader.

item.title: Flávio vai a ato de aliado em MG, acena a Cleitinho e diz que esperou 'até o último minuto' por ele
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL party's presidential candidate, attended the launch of the party's Minas Gerais gubernatorial campaign in Belo Horizonte. At the event, he reached out to Senator Cleitinho of the Republicans, who leads polls for the state governorship, saying he had waited 'until the last minute' for his support.

item.title: A boa notícia para Flávio Bolsonaro em pesquisa BTG/Nexus
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll shows Lula leading with 41% against Flávio Bolsonaro's 36% in the first round, but a technical tie in a potential second-round scenario (47% to 44%), within the margin of error. José Benedito da Silva, VEJA's politics editor, calls this 'good news' for Flávio, as it suggests Lula cannot win outright in the first round and the race remains highly competitive, making the runoff the decisive stage for the Bolsonaro campaign.

item.title: O erro que Lula cometeu apesar de todos os alertas e que agora virou problema na Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: Despite warnings about the use of public funds and electoral risks, Lula proceeded with the Acadêmicos de Niterói samba parade in his honor, ignoring alerts from allies and analysts. Although other government figures were withdrawn from the event, Lula remained the sole official representative, exposing himself to political risks such as public backlash or the school’s relegation — which ultimately occurred. The incident is now under scrutiny by electoral justice as a potential case of illegal campaigning and misuse of public resources.

item.title: 'Nem o filho de Lula quer morar no Brasil', ironiza Nikolas sobre mensagens trocadas com lobista investigada
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) mocked the message exchange between Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) and lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, investigated for alleged involvement in an INSS fraud scheme, saying 'not even Lula’s son wants to live in Brazil'. The comment was made during the launch of Flávio Roscoe’s (PL) candidacy for governor of Minas Gerais, backed by Flávio Bolsonaro. The messages, under analysis by the Federal Police, reveal Lulinha and Luchsinger discussing a future in Switzerland and dissatisfaction with Brazil, to which Lulinha responds with disdain for local conditions.

item.title: EUA troca chefe de escritório das relações com Brasil e América Latina
item.description: The Trump administration has appointed Juan Pablo Segura as the new Assistant Secretary for Western Hemisphere Affairs, replacing Michael Kozak. The appointment comes amid deteriorating U.S.-Brazil relations marked by trade disputes and political disagreements. Segura stated he will advance President Trump’s agenda focused on border security, countering narcoterrorism, and generating prosperity for the U.S. and its partners.

item.title: Zema diz que programas sociais criam ‘geração de imprestáveis’
item.description: Romeu Zema, presidential candidate for the Novo party, criticized social programs for creating a 'generation of unemployables' who refuse to work and prefer informal jobs, passing this behavior from parent to child. He advocates requiring beneficiaries to accept jobs and proposes a 'structured exit door' linking social programs to vocational training and employment, including the Casas da Cidadania initiative for vulnerable families.

item.title: Irmão de Cleitinho explica desentendimento com o Republicanos na candidatura em Minas Gerais
item.description: Gleidson Azevedo, brother of Senator Cleitinho and federal deputy candidate, revealed he considered withdrawing his candidacy after the Republicans opposed his brother's bid for Minas Gerais governor. He stated the decision was tied to the belief that without Cleitinho in the race, continuing his own campaign made no sense. Family and popular pressure, including a trip to Brasilia with his mother, contributed to Cleitinho reversing his decision and maintaining his candidacy.

item.title: Augusto Cury sugere Tarcísio como primeiro-ministro
item.description: Augusto Cury, presidential candidate for Avante, advocated for adopting a parliamentary system in Brazil, proposing that the country should have a prime minister. He specifically cited Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) as an ideal candidate for the role, criticizing the current presidential model for concentrating excessive power in the president.

item.title: Tarcísio: "Ou o Brasil acaba com a bet ou a bet acaba com o Brasil"
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas, candidate for re-election as governor of São Paulo, stated that gambling addiction ('bets') is a mental health issue requiring the same decisive action taken against tobacco. He noted that São Paulo is the first state with a professional training and treatment program for gambling addiction, though access remains limited in other public health units. Mental health will be a pillar of his potential new term.

item.title: “Ou o Brasil acaba com bets, ou bets acabam com o Brasil”, diz Tarcísio
item.description: São Paulo gubernatorial candidate Tarcísio de Freitas criticized online betting at the 'Diálogos da Saúde' event, calling it a public health issue that consumes 20% to 25% of Brazilians' income and reduces productivity. He compared the challenge of regulating bets to past anti-tobacco efforts and pledged, if re-elected, to implement a public mental health program to address gambling addiction, though he provided no details on funding or implementation.

item.title: Renan Santos diz que CLT restringe o trabalhador e defende MEI
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate for the Missão party, criticized the CLT for restricting workers and employers, advocating for the MEI as a viable formalization alternative. He argued that current labor legislation makes formal hiring unfeasible and that many Brazilians rely on government aid and informal work, with new jobs—especially for youth—being created via MEI.

item.title: Flávio promete dobrar presídios federais e repetir “padrão Bukele”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a presidential candidate, pledged to double the number of federal prisons in Brazil, advocating for a 'tough-on-crime' approach inspired by El Salvador's security model, known as the 'Bukele pattern'. The statement was made following the launch of Flávio Roscoe's candidacy for governor of Minas Gerais in Belo Horizonte.

item.title: Pouco conhecido, Roscoe prevê campanha com cinco idas de Flávio Bolsonaro a Minas antes do primeiro turno
item.description: Flávio Roscoe (PL-MG), candidate for governor of Minas Gerais, said he expects Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-MG) to visit the state five times before the first round of the 2026 election. Bolsonaro’s presence alongside Roscoe is seen as key to increasing the businessman’s name recognition among voters, currently at just 2% in the Genial/Quaest poll. Roscoe denied that Cleitinho Azevedo’s support for Bolsonaro splits the right-wing vote, arguing his candidacy strengthens Bolsonarism in the state and nationally.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que dialogará por dívida de MG e que adotará 'padrão Bukele' de segurança
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential candidate for the PL party, stated that if elected, he intends to dialogue with the next governor of Minas Gerais to address the state's debt, emphasizing that the federal government should assist states regardless of political alignment. He also said he would adopt a 'Bukele-style' security model, referring to Nayib Bukele's crime reduction approach in El Salvador.

item.title: Nikolas alfineta Lula: "Nem o filho dele quer morar aqui"
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL) criticized President Lula during a speech in Belo Horizonte, citing intercepted Federal Police messages in which Lula’s son, Lulinha, reportedly said his place was to live in Switzerland. Nikolas argued that if even Lula’s son doesn’t want to live in Brazil, the left must be in trouble, and presented the PL’s Minas Gerais ticket as winning. The remarks were made at the launch of Flávio Roscoe’s gubernatorial campaign, with Flávio Bolsonaro also present.

item.title: Augusto Cury diz que Brasil já é parlamentarista e que precisa de um primeiro-ministro como Tarcísio de Freitas
item.description: Presidential candidate Augusto Cury (Avante) stated that Brazil already operates as a de facto parliamentary system and advocated for the creation of a prime minister role, suggesting the ideal profile would be similar to Governor Tarcísio de Freitas. He argued that shifting part of executive power to Congress through a prime minister responsible for budget management and daily administration would make the country more modern and efficient. Cury also said that, if elected, he would seek to establish a major national pact based on dialogue with various sectors.

item.title: Corregedor aceita ação do Novo contra Lula por desfile de Carnaval
item.description: The Electoral Justice Corregedor accepted a lawsuit filed by the Novo party against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Vice President Geraldo Alckmin, alleging economic power abuse and improper use of media due to a Carnival parade funded with R$9.65 million in public money and centered on Lula’s trajectory. The acceptance does not imply guilt but authorizes an investigation, with a 5-day deadline for the accused to present their defense.

item.title: Lula sobre el petróleo descubierto frente a la Amazonia: “Esto significa soberanía nacional”
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva celebrated the discovery of oil off the Amazon coast near the Equator, calling it a matter of national sovereignty. He traveled 175 kilometers offshore to the mouth of the Amazon River to inspect the Petrobras-operated exploration vessel. Lula stated that a country possessing such oil will not allow foreign interference, linking the find to his 2026 re-election campaign.

item.title: Com Trump e bandeira americana, Flávio ameaça o Brasil com um outro tipo de golpe
item.description: The article highlights that Flávio Bolsonaro has been using American flags in his campaign, replacing the traditional 'Homeland and Family' slogan, raising concerns about a possible surrender of national interests to the U.S. under Trump's influence. It suggests that his election could lead to economic concessions, such as accepting U.S. corn ethanol and lacking regulation on American companies, along with risks of military interventions in Brazilian borders under the pretext of combating PCC and CV. While a military coup is deemed unlikely due to Armed Forces resistance, the risk of an 'economic or sovereignty coup' is real, with Lula positioned to exploit this narrative in the campaign.

item.title: Marçal volta a propor mudança da capital federal ao Maranhão
item.description: Pablo Marçal, presidential candidate for the PRTB, proposed moving Brazil's federal capital to Maranhão, likening the idea to Juscelino Kubitschek's construction of Brasília, without specifying a city. He also suggested creating four additional thematic capitals: Rio de Janeiro (tourism), São Paulo (finance), and Pará and Minas Gerais (mining), while keeping the judicial capital in Brasília. Although Marçal remains ineligible until 2032 due to abuse of political and economic power in 2024, a court allowed his retroactive affiliation with PRTB, though his candidacy still requires TSE approval.

item.title: Após rompimento, Lula e Alcolumbre trocam elogios
item.description: Lula and Davi Alcolumbre appeared together publicly for the first time in over three months, aboard a Petrobras survey ship off the coast of Amapá, where oil was detected. The meeting signaled the end of a political rift between the two, featuring mutual praise during the event.

item.title: Influência dos partidos, emoções em relação a candidatos, sonhos dos brasileiros: veja novos dados da pesquisa Quaest
item.description: The Quaest poll shows Brazilian voters are split on whether a candidate's party influences their presidential vote: 38% say it influences a lot, 37% say it has no influence, and 22% say it has little influence. Hope is the dominant emotion toward candidates (34%), especially among the poorest (38%), while the top dreams are having good health (19%), living in a violence-free place (15%), and the happiness of family and friends (12%).

item.title: Flávio celebra apoio de Cleitinho, mas diz que seu candidato é Roscoe
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro celebrated Senator Cleitinho Azevedo's support for his presidential candidacy, despite Cleitinho running for governor of Minas Gerais against the PL's official candidate, Flávio Roscoe. He emphasized that Cleitinho's support does not change the PL's stance in Minas, reaffirming Roscoe as the party's candidate and stating he will campaign on Roscoe's ticket to seek votes.

item.title: Em MG, Flávio promete quadruplicar pena mínima para ladrão de celular
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL party's presidential candidate, promised to quadruple the minimum sentence for cellphone thieves during an event in Belo Horizonte, stating the measure aims to end impunity and protect Brazilians, as cellphones contain their entire personal lives. He also extended the punishment to receivers of stolen goods. The event was part of Flávio Roscoe's campaign for governor of Minas Gerais.

item.title: Tarcísio: Brasil tem que acabar com bet ou bet acaba com o Brasil
item.description: São Paulo Governor and re-election candidate Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) advocated for combating online betting (bets), linking their rise to mental health issues and declining productivity in Brazil. He warned that the country must end betting or betting will end Brazil, emphasizing concerns about the social impact of digital gambling.

item.title: Roscoe: Flávio Bolsonaro deve vir em MG cinco vezes até fim do primeiro turno
item.description: Flávio Roscoe, the PL candidate for governor of Minas Gerais, said he expects Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL presidential candidate, to make at least five campaign visits to the state before the first round of elections on October 4. He added that the date for the next visit will be set on Tuesday, the 18th.

item.title: Renan Santos promete intervenção na segurança pública em 'praticamente todos os Estados'
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential candidate, stated he would implement federal interventions in 'practically all' states regarding public security if elected in October. He specifically mentioned using this prerogative against Rio de Janeiro and suggested it could also apply to Ceará and Bahia.

item.title: Lulinha orientou Roberta Luchsinger a cobrar empresário investigado pela PF?
item.description: Messages between Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) and lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger indicate that he instructed her to bill businessman Cléber Reis, owner of 3Structure It Ltda, who is under investigation by the Federal Police and received over R$ 80 million in federal contracts. The content suggests possible use of influence to favor private interests tied to companies with public contracts.

item.title: Pablo Marçal aponta erro em declaração de R$ 7,4 bilhões ao TSE e pede retificação de patrimônio
item.description: Candidate Pablo Marçal stated that the R$ 7.4 billion figure reported in his asset declaration to the TSE was due to a typing error. He requested a correction of the record, emphasizing the importance of accuracy in asset disclosures for electoral transparency. Asset declarations are mandatory for all candidates running for elected office in Brazil.

item.title: Renan Santos chama militares de “vagabundos” em sabatina
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate for the Missão party and MBL co-founder, stated during an SBT News interview that part of the Brazilian military does not fulfill its duties and called them "vagabonds". He also advocated for including the military in a future pension reform and criticized labor protections under the CLT.

item.title: Campanha começa com Lula e Flávio dominando 67% das conversas nas redes e 3ª via com falta de tempo
item.description: The 2026 election campaign begins with Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro dominating 67.4% of online conversations, while third-way candidates struggle to gain sustainable visibility. Lula showed significant improvement in positive mentions, rising from 34.2% to 45.5%, while Flávio recovered from below 30% to 43.5% after the Master case. Renan Santos maintains stable presence outside polarization, whereas Caiado and Zema exhibit sporadic spikes without continuity.

item.title: Presidenciáveis iniciam campanha eleitoral em redutos históricos para mobilizar bases
item.description: On the first day of the official electoral campaign, presidential candidates focused their events in historical strongholds, selecting strategic locations to reinforce their core messages and mobilize their electoral bases. The choice of these symbolic sites reflects detailed planning by campaign marketing committees, aiming to embed narratives in the popular imagination from the outset of street-level campaigning.

item.title: Renan Santos: 'O que mais tem no Brasil é militar vagabundo que não faz nada'
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate from the Missão à Presidência party, claimed Brazil has a large number of 'lazy' military personnel who, instead of fighting criminal factions, prefer spending time at military clubs. He criticized the Armed Forces' inactivity amid rising organized violence.

item.title: Mensagens de Lulinha anexadas pela PF sugerem intermediação de agendas junto ao Planalto
item.description: Messages from Lulinha, son of President Lula, attached to PF investigations suggest he acted as an intermediary to schedule contacts with the presidential office. The communications were obtained in STF-authorized inquiries into suspected influence peddling and illegal consultancy contracts. The case raises concerns about the use of familial influence to gain access to government decision-making.

item.title: Roscoe celebra apoio de Cleitinho a Flávio Bolsonaro em MG
item.description: Flávio Roscoe, the PL candidate for governor of Minas Gerais, celebrated the support of Senator Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos) for Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) presidential bid, stating the support came because of the PL’s gubernatorial candidacy in Minas Gerais. The campaign launch event took place at Mackenzie Esporte Clube in Belo Horizonte, featuring Flávio Bolsonaro and over 100 legislative candidates, with whom Roscoe recorded supportive videos. Roscoe emphasized Bolsonaro’s importance to his electoral strategy, including joint committees, digital media, and radio/TV advertising, noting his coalition will have the second-largest TV time allocation.

item.title: Petrobras diz não saber quanto de petróleo há na Margem Equatorial
item.description: Petrobras President Magda Chambriard stated the company does not yet know the exact volume of oil reserves in the Equatorial Margin but remains optimistic following initial discoveries at the Morpho well in block FZA-M-59, 175 km off the coast of Amapá. The drilling is in the exploratory phase, with plans to drill three more wells in the same block and five in the broader area, backed by a projected $3 billion investment. Production hinges on commercial confirmation, development planning, and new environmental licensing.

item.title: TSE aceita ação sobre financiamento público de desfile no carnaval que homenageou Lula
item.description: The TSE has accepted a lawsuit filed by the Novo Party investigating the use of R$ 9.65 million in public funds to finance the Acadêmicos de Niterói samba school's Carnival 2025 parade, which honored President Lula. The action alleges economic abuse of power and premature electoral propaganda, as the funding was formalized after the tribute was announced in July 2025 and occurred outside the electoral propaganda regime. Lula and Geraldo Alckmin have five days to present their defense.
